import importlib
import pathlib
import subprocess
import types
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

path = pathlib.Path("tools/tests/test_m7_linux_task_graph.py").resolve()
before = types.ModuleType("before_count_regression")
before.__file__ = str(path)
exec(compile(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "d82efcbaa93654607afbb36c74ef432b871ed214:tools/tests/test_m7_linux_task_graph.py"], text=True), str(path), "exec"), before.__dict__)
after = importlib.import_module("tools.tests.test_m7_linux_task_graph")

def corrupted_read(original):
    def read(self, relative):
        text = original(self, relative)
        if relative == "docs/planning/implementation-backlog.md":
            assert "**当前发布任务数：** 208" in text
            text = text.replace("**当前发布任务数：** 208", "**当前发布任务数：** 207", 1)
        return text
    return read

old_class = before.M7LinuxTaskGraphTests
with patch.object(old_class, "read", corrupted_read(old_class.read)):
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(old_class))
    assert result.wasSuccessful(), "old suite unexpectedly detects stale total"
    print("BEFORE_FIX: corrupted total missed; 3 tests passed")
new_class = after.M7LinuxTaskGraphTests
with patch.object(new_class, "read", corrupted_read(new_class.read)):
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite([new_class("test_task_counts_include_linux_profile_and_formal_follow_up_work")]))
    assert len(result.failures) == 1 and not result.errors, "stale total was not rejected"
    print("AFTER_FIX_NEGATIVE: corrupted total rejected by derived invariant")
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(new_class))
assert result.wasSuccessful()
print("AFTER_FIX_VALID: all 4 task graph tests passed")
